_comment: Audit trail of every keyword research run. One entry per run — used to debug queue state and verify deduplication history.

runs.notes: First manual run. Competitor identification returned empty — domain too new/small for Ahrefs organic competitor tracking. 'free seating chart template' dropped at dedup check — already a secondary keyword of published article wedding-seating-chart-template.

Mechanical guardrail (Step 3) passed 22 unique keywords after within-batch and cross-set dedup, but manual relevance curation discarded 13 of those before queueing, beyond what the substring inclusion/exclusion filter alone catches: 'pew' and 'rentals' and 'seating' are bare dictionary words that only match because the guardrail terms themselves ('pew', 'rental', 'seating') are substrings of them, with Ahrefs parent_topics confirming unrelated intent (e.g. 'pew' -> parent topic 'black'). 'guest list' was confirmed off-topic by its own SERP, which is dominated by the novel/show 'The Guest List' by Lucy Foley, not wedding planning content. 'foam board near me' SERP is dominated by local hardware/craft listings (Sutherlands, Office Depot) for raw foam board, not printed seating charts -- poor fit for a customer already choosing a finished product. 'free seating chart maker for teachers' and 'free classroom seating chart maker' carry classroom/education intent, not wedding intent (neither 'classroom' nor 'teacher' happen to be in the exclusion list, only 'school' is -- a gap worth adding to guardrails.exclusion_any). 'seating chart printable' and 'how to make a seating chart' are near-duplicates of the already-published wedding-seating-chart-template and how-to-make-a-wedding-seating-chart articles (which predate the queue system and have no queue_id to attach cluster_siblings to) and were dropped to avoid cannibalization. 'rental service', 'arch wedding', 'standard foam board size', and 'reception tables' matched guardrail terms by coincidence but describe products/services Howard Wedding Rentals does not offer (only the four active pillars: church pew rental, place cards, seating chart boards, seating chart tool). 'church pews' (plural of the already-published 'church pew') was added as a cluster_sibling of kw-001 instead of a new queue entry to avoid splitting ranking signal for a near-identical query. Net: 8 new queue entries (kw-008 through kw-015) and 1 cluster_siblings update.

Zero net-new queue entries this run — the four pillars are maturing and nearly every mechanically-passing candidate collided with an already-published or already-queued keyword, or repeated a discard already ruled on in research-run-002. Exact-dup / secondary-keyword blocks: 'church pew', 'church pews', 'place cards wedding' (secondary_keyword of wedding-place-cards-guide), 'wedding name tags' (kw-002), 'wedding escort cards' (kw-011), 'table numbers' (kw-009), 'free seating chart template' (secondary_keyword of wedding-seating-chart-template), 'place cards' (kw-010), 'seating plan software' (kw-014), 'template for seating chart' (kw-012). Preserved-skip blocks (never resurrected): 'place cards for table' (kw-005), 'wedding ceremony chair layout template' (kw-006), 'table seating chart wedding' (kw-013, already queued not skipped -- exact match). Repeat discards matching research-run-002's own prior rulings, applied again this run: 'guest list' (off-topic SERP; also kd33 now exceeds the phase-1 ceiling), 'foam board near me' (raw hardware-store intent, not a finished product buyer), 'standard foam board size' (product we don't sell), 'seating chart printable' and 'how to make a seating chart' (near-duplicates of predate-system articles with no queue_id), 'free classroom seating chart maker' and 'free seating chart maker for teachers' (classroom/teacher intent -- this run finally closes the guardrail gap flagged last run by adding 'classroom' and 'teacher' to guardrails.exclusion_any). Two new manual cannibalization calls this run, following the same no-queue_id precedent as research-run-002: 'table place cards' (vol 1200, kd 5) and 'wedding seating chart examples' (vol 100, kd 0) both carry a parent_topic that exactly matches a published article's primary_keyword (wedding-place-cards-guide and wedding-seating-chart-template respectively), neither of which has a queue_id to attach a cluster_sibling to -- discarded rather than risk splitting ranking signal. KD-ceiling fails this run (phase 1 ceiling is 25): 'wedding place cards template' (kd33), 'what are escort cards wedding' (kd44), 'seating chart examples' bare form (kd28), 'place cards' bare related-terms pull (kd26, though already queued anyway), 'free seating chart maker' bare related-terms pull (kd26, though already published anyway). One genuine cluster_sibling addition: 'sitting chart' (vol 150, kd 5) shares parent_topic 'seating chart maker' with kw-008 and was appended to its cluster_siblings array rather than creating a new entry. Net: 0 new queue entries, 1 cluster_siblings update, config.json guardrails.exclusion_any gained 'classroom' and 'teacher'.

Four maturing pillars continue to shrink the net-new pool. church-pew-rentals yielded zero candidates above the volume floor (100) beyond exact dup/secondary-keyword blocks ('what is a church pew', 'how much does a church pew weigh', 'church pew') -- this pillar's keyword universe appears largely exhausted at phase-1 volume/KD thresholds; related-terms pulls were dominated by off-topic noise ('vintage', 'southern california', 'rental service' kd83, bare 'pew' kd69/'rentals' kd2 -- both coincidental guardrail matches describing unrelated products, consistent with run-002's precedent). place-cards pillar: one new entry added, 'wedding place cards template' (vol150, kd16, tp400) -- SERP-verified genuinely wedding-specific (Canva, Avery, Pinterest, PlaceCardMe all target wedding place-card templates specifically), angled as a DIY-template comparison piece distinct from the published 'wedding-place-cards-guide' and 'what-are-place-cards' articles. Dedup/precedent blocks in this pillar: 'place cards wedding' and 'wedding name tags' and 'wedding escort cards' and 'table numbers' and 'place cards' and 'where to print place cards for wedding' (exact matches to published primary/secondary keywords), 'custom place cards' (exact secondary_keyword match), 'table place cards' (vol1200 kd4 -- repeat discard of research-run-003's own cannibalization ruling against the no-queue_id 'wedding place cards' predate-system article), 'place cards for table' and permanently-skipped kw-005 preserved as skipped, not resurrected. seating-chart-boards pillar: zero new standalone entries -- 'wedding seating chart examples' (vol100 kd0) and 'seating chart printable' (vol200 kd8) are repeat discards of run-002/run-003's cannibalization rulings against the no-queue_id 'wedding-seating-chart-template' article. 'foam board poster' (vol2200 kd3, tp7600) mechanically passed every guardrail and scored 80.2 but was discarded after SERP sampling confirmed the same intent mismatch flagged for 'foam board near me' in run-002: the SERP is dominated by office-supply/hardware retailers (FedEx Office, Staples, Walmart, Office Depot, Dollar Tree) selling raw foam board and generic poster printing, not wedding seating-chart buyers -- not worth the content investment despite the attractive metrics. One cluster_sibling addition: 'seating charts wedding' (parent_topic exactly matches kw-013's parent_topic 'wedding seating chart') appended to kw-013. seating-chart-tool pillar: zero new standalone entries -- 'free seating chart maker' and 'seating chart' are exact dup/primary-keyword matches (kw-004, kw-008); 'how to make a seating chart' is a third consecutive repeat discard of the same no-queue_id cannibalization call against 'how-to-make-a-wedding-seating-chart' (now flagged across three runs running -- worth eventually backfilling a queue_id for that predate-system article so future runs can cluster against it instead of discarding outright); 'wedding seating chart' hit Check E directly (its own string is kw-013's parent_topic, already in the dedup set). One cluster_sibling addition: 'free seating chart' (parent_topic exactly matches kw-008's parent_topic 'seating chart maker') appended to kw-008. classroom/teacher exclusion terms (added in run-003) correctly caught 6 more classroom-intent candidates this run ('free seating chart maker for classroom', 'free seating chart maker for teachers', etc.) before they reached scoring. Net: 1 new queue entry (kw-016), 2 cluster_siblings updates, 0 competitor domains (unchanged -- site still too small for Ahrefs organic-competitor tracking).

All four pillars continue to shrink the net-new pool (run-004 already flagged church-pew-rentals and place-cards as largely exhausted at phase-1 thresholds; this run confirms both again yielded zero candidates past exact-dup/secondary-keyword/parent_topic blocks against published articles and queue entries). church-pew-rentals: zero candidates -- related-terms pulls were dominated by off-topic noise ('pew' kd79, 'rentals' vol34000 real-estate intent, 'rental service' kd83, 'southern california', 'vintage' -- all coincidental guardrail matches describing unrelated products, consistent with run-002 precedent). place-cards: zero candidates -- 'wedding name place cards' and 'table place cards' both carry a parent_topic ('wedding place cards') that exactly matches the published wedding-place-cards-guide article's primary_keyword, which predates the queue system and has no queue_id to attach a cluster_sibling to -- discarded to avoid cannibalization, same precedent as run-003/run-004. seating-chart-boards: zero standalone candidates -- 'wedding seating chart examples' (parent_topic 'wedding seating chart template', no-queue_id predate-system article) and 'wedding reception seating chart ideas' (parent_topic 'wedding seating chart ideas', no-queue_id predate-system article) are repeat cannibalization discards. 'seating chart printable' is a third consecutive repeat discard of the same no-queue_id cannibalization call flagged in run-002 and run-003. Foam-board candidates continue to fail on relevance despite passing guardrails mechanically: 'foam board custom' (vol100, kd0, tp700) was SERP-sampled this run and confirmed dominated by office-supply/print-shop retailers (48HourPrint, Staples, VistaPrint, FedEx Office, GotPrint) selling raw/blank foam board, not finished seating-chart-board buyers -- same intent mismatch as 'foam board poster' (run-004) and 'foam board near me' (run-002), both repeat-discarded again this run. 'standard foam board size' is a repeat discard (product we don't sell) per run-002/run-003. 'reception tables' is a repeat discard (product we don't sell) per run-002. New this run: 'mega seating plan' (vol500, kd0, tp450) mechanically passed every guardrail and scored ~44, but SERP sampling revealed it is a branded classroom/education seating-plan software product (compared against Tyler SIS Classroom 360 and PerfectTablePlan for schools in its own SERP) -- a navigational brand query, not a wedding content opportunity -- discarded despite the attractive metrics, same pattern as 'foam board poster' in run-004. seating-chart-tool: zero standalone candidates -- 'free seating chart maker', 'template for seating chart', and 'seating plan software' are exact primary_keyword matches to published/queued entries; all classroom/teacher-intent candidates ('free seating chart maker for teachers', 'free classroom seating chart maker', etc.) were correctly caught by the exclusion list closed in run-003. One resolution of a long-standing gap: 'how to make a seating chart' (vol150, kd19, tp7800) has previously been discarded three runs running (run-002, run-003, run-004) as a cannibalization risk against the no-queue_id predate-system article 'how-to-make-a-wedding-seating-chart'. This run, Ahrefs' own parent_topic for the term ('seating chart maker') was checked against the dedup set and found to exactly match kw-008's parent_topic -- and kw-008 ('seating chart', published, queue_id present) is a valid attachment point per Step 3 Check F, unlike the predate-system article. Appended as a cluster_sibling of kw-008 instead of discarding a fourth time. Net: 0 new queue entries, 1 cluster_siblings update, 0 competitor domains (unchanged -- site still too small for Ahrefs organic-competitor tracking). All four pillars are now at or near phase-1 keyword-universe exhaustion; consider either advancing to phase 2 (kd_ceiling 40, min_volume 150) ahead of schedule, or adding a fifth pillar/seed-term set, since several real candidates this run (table seating chart variants, escort-card variants) were blocked only by the current phase-1 KD ceiling or by cannibalization against predate-system articles lacking queue_ids.

Owner-approved 5th pillar (nashville-pew-rentals). Phase-1 thresholds kept (kd<=25, vol>=100). Ahrefs US: every pew-rental keyword is below the volume floor: pew rental 10, church pew rental 20, rent church pews 20, church pew rental near me 10, rent church pews near me 10, church pews for rent near me 10, pews for rent 10, rent pews for outdoor wedding 10, wedding pews for rent 0, church pew rental nashville / wedding pew rental nashville / pew rental near me / church pew rental cost 0 or no data. Nothing queued. Non-rental terms that pass mechanically were rejected: church pews (vol2000 kd1) is a parent_topic dupe of published kw-001 'church pew' and is shopping/buy intent; wedding venues nashville (600, kd1) is a venue-directory SERP we cannot win. Near misses: outdoor wedding venues nashville (80, kd2); wedding rentals nashville (100, kd40, fails KD). Pillar registered so the bi-weekly run seeds it; likely needs a per-pillar volume floor override or local-landing-page (non-blog) treatment to ever queue.
